china_race_dynamics.text: We saw with social media what happens when tech companies operate without meaningful regulation and cannot let it happen again when it comes to AI. [...] I support common sense regulation that allows America to maintain it's edge over China on AI without allowing the harms we've seen with unchecked technology companies financially incentivized to do the wrong thing.

deepseek.reason: The speaker says common-sense AI regulation should let America maintain its edge over China.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly frames maintaining an AI edge over China as a goal.
